name: Oz Stormwind
description: Oz Stormwind (LG), known as the Skyhunter, is a ranger-paladin leading the Emerald Guardians. He is an extraordinary warrior and an exceptional hunter, adept at swiftly locating and descending upon the corrupted with astonishing dives, striking fear in them, showing no worldly desires to divert his righteous focus. He sees himself as a role model to his people, going to great pains to act and be what they need him to be, often shouldering more than he can. He is often at odds with extremist or pragmatic Cirrus, as Oz is adamant about righteousness over consequences, believing soul purity is more important than anything. Sometimes, the extremists use the negative mundane consequences of his thinking to point out Oz’s idealism and unpractical expectations. His ultimate aspiration is to join Archangel Ascaran in the battle against the Ungods. However, Oz believes he must achieve more remarkable feats to earn his place among the angels. To this end, he seeks to destroy the demon Vanarus, suspecting a connection between him and Emperor Baleroth. He aims to expose the Tanarean Empire and pave the way for Ben’net to achieve freedom. Oz often recruits adventurers to gather information on Vanarus’ whereabouts, offering generous rewards. He also fosters heroism, aiding promising, good-aligned adventurers. No one knows Oz’s other soul, which has never been seen manifested. Some believe he has achieved a legendary fusion of both aspects, while others speculate that he never sleeps. There are rumors of the two souls despising each other, with whispers that his counterpart may even serve the Ungods.
